LocalHide

Locally hide and protect messages in Discord DMs. A Kettu/Vendetta-compatible plugin for iOS.

Install: in Discord → Settings → Plugins → paste this URL:

https://uchumeow.is-a.dev/LocalHide/dist/LocalHide/

Hidden messages stay on your device only. No deletes, no edits, no network requests. See the GitHub repository for docs (README, SECURITY, TESTING checklists).
